latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches "maker-for-beginners", enabling simple, AI-powered video creation and export from raw phone clips.
- One-step setup: connect automatically to cloud processing with or without a token.
- Supports drag-and-drop video upload, intuitive text prompts, and fast 1080p MP4 export.
- Provides clear mappings from user intents (edit, export, check credits, upload) to actions.
- Integrates session management, cloud render queue, and error handling for a smooth beginner experience.
